## What happened

Describe what you expected versus what you saw (agent behavior, docs, or repo layout).

## Where

Link or path (for example `.github/agents/revibe.agent.md`, a prompt file, or `README.md` section).

## Suggested fix (optional)

If you already have a wording or structural fix in mind, summarize it. PRs that change `revibe.agent.md` should explain the learning outcome, not only the text diff.
